LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 2.3.1 WORD CLASSES: COLLECTIVE NOUNS.

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns.
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns., part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why are there different types of nouns? 2. How do collective nouns form their plurals?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify collective nouns from a text,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns. in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. use singular and plural forms of collective nouns correctly in sentences,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns. in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. enjoy using collective nouns in communication. ● Guide the learners to list collective nouns as they listen to an audio text. ● Guide the learners to identify collective nouns in a print or braille text. ● In pairs, guide the learners to classify collective nouns according to people, animals or things. ● In groups, guide the learners to discuss the plural forms of these nouns. ● Guide the learners to write correct sentences using collective nouns from substitution tables. Learners with blindness use a braille substitution table with embossed outlines. 1. Why are there different types of nouns? 2. How do collective nouns form their plurals? 19 ● Learners fill or complete blank spaces using the correct collective nouns. ● Guide the learners to fill in crossword puzzles using collective nouns. Learners with blindness pick braille letter cards from a pool and arrange them to form collective nouns. ● Guide the learners to search for more examples of collective nouns from print or braille or non-print text. ● Learners practise constructing sentences using the collective nouns they have identified.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word classes: Collective Nouns. together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn as the learner participates in discussions with others on plural forms of collective nouns.

● Communication as the learner develops effective communication through verbal expression, written communication and in

collaborative activities.

● Collaboration as the learner works in collaboration with others in pairs and groups to construct sentences.

Values:
Unity: A learner enhances this value as they work in pairs and groups with others contributing ideas to

fill in crossword puzzles using collective nouns

Link to other subjects:

• Braille letter cards
